visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair, wearing a yellow and black baseball cap and a matching 'Brothers' jersey with the number 9, stands in front of a blue backdrop featuring various sponsor logos. He holds a small black Sony microphone in his right hand. He smiles and speaks directly toward an off-camera interviewer, occasionally looking up as if recalling a story. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional interview setting. (2) The scene cuts to an indoor corridor or locker room area. A woman wearing glasses and a blue t-shirt stands on the left, holding a microphone and gesturing with her hands while speaking. Beside her stands a tall man with dreadlocks, wearing a navy blue athletic shirt and white pants. He smiles and laughs as she speaks, leaning slightly away from her. The background features a large banner that says 'MOST VALUABLE PLAYER' along with baseball team logos. The lighting is slightly more natural compared to the first studio-like setting.

(7) [Subtitle]: 我最喜歡的洋將就是他. (8) [Subtitle]: 我自己也會請 不是只有叫他請!. (9) [Subtitle]: 究竟保拉會怎麼回應呢. (10) [Subtitle]: 他說他的想法是. (11) [Subtitle]: 我們如果現在是聯盟第一的球隊. (12) [Subtitle]: 我們就值得喝星巴克😆. (13) [Subtitle]: 那我們現在第四名第五名的話. (14) [Variety]: (賽後回到第三名了). (15) [Subtitle]: 就喝7-11就好🤣🤣🤣.
